session.name: H3 turbo LoRA bench + acceleration research (SolAttn / SageAttention / EasyCache)

goal.original: Check the viability of SolAttn, SageAttention and EasyCache for MiniMax H3, LTX and WAN - what nodes, processes and pip packages they need, how safe those are to install - and card whatever is worth adding. Mid-session a just-released MiniMax H3 Turbo LoRA was found and became the main thread.
goal.summary: The turbo LoRA is the win: 204s -> 96s at 864x480 warm, authored into both H3 raw graphs and committed, weight staged and verified on R2. SageAttention and SolAttn are rejected with reasons; LTX and WAN are out of scope because both are already step-distilled upstream. What remains is repo plumbing: sync the workflows, add the dep entry, wire the app-side control.

key_decisions: Turbo is OPT-IN with quality slightly below the 20-step path - the user's explicit call, so the 20-step path stays the default and EasyCache's -22% lands on the primary path rather than an edge case

LoRA strength is value-gated (MpiMath 1.0/0.0 driving BOTH strength_model and strength_clip), not branch-gated - house pattern, and the AND short-circuit in MpiLoraModelClip is what skips the file load
Single-pass uses MpiIfElseInverted on the latent, not lazy refusal: an ExecutionBlocker travels downstream only, and the stage-1 sampler is downstream of the latent split
A sibling h3Turbo control rather than reusing krea2Turbo, which emits prompt:krea2-turbo to hide the negative-prompt toggle and would share one perModel storage key across model families
SolAttn gets no card - documented verdict only. Reopen only if kijai adds a LICENSE and an LTX branch
LTX/WAN explicitly out of scope: already distilled upstream, and their seams are load-bearing
constraints: The raw templates are exported but NOT synced - raw/ and the runtime files are currently out of step. Nothing is broken for users because no runtime file changed, but do the sync before anything else
First run after flipping an injected boolean is NOT warm - it produced a false 5% regression this session. Discard run 1 of every config
A model-side widget change (MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, LoRA strength/name) costs a ~19s re-patch. Seed-only changes stay warm. Never compare across a re-patch
Same seed + same graph = execution_cached and measures nothing. Vary seeds between repeats; pair them across configs
864x480 is the app's baked default (generate_h3.py). Half this session's early numbers were taken at 864x408 by mistake and were wrong by 3x - state the resolution beside every number
progressStages.js needs single: 2 -> single: 1 on both H3 rows IF single-pass ships. Turbo needs no new axis - it changes bar length, not bar count. A wrong count is worse than a missing one
shift_audio 4/5/6 made no audible difference (verified not a plumbing fault - ModelPatcher.clone preserves object_patches and model_options). Baked at 5. The audio fix was euler/beta
EasyCache is currently ungated in the graphs, so it runs under turbo where it skips 0 of 8 steps. Gate it off turbo
